_comment: Shared Splunk Platform version defaults and compatibility metadata, verified 2026-08-20. Enterprise entries are recognized release trains and remain listed when an end date is needed for lifecycle classification; Cloud entries identify current documentation trains.

upgrade_notes_10_4.kvstore_mongodb: Enterprise 10.4 removes MongoDB 4-6 binaries. Upgrade 9.x to 10.0 or 10.2 before 10.4. On 10.x, MongoDB 8 is applied automatically during upgrade.
upgrade_notes_10_4.tls: Enterprise 10.4 removes TLS 1.0 and 1.1 negotiation between Splunk components. Use TLS 1.2 or higher.
upgrade_notes_10_4.config_validation: Enterprise 10.4 introduces Config Validation for .conf changes before production impact.
upgrade_notes_10_4.enterprise_no_10_3_train: There is no Splunk Enterprise 10.3 release train; Cloud 10.3.x stacks are Cloud-only.

upgrade_notes_10_6.kvstore_migration: Upgrade to Enterprise 10.6 automatically migrates supported KV Store deployments to cohosted KV Store backed by a PostgreSQL Storage sidecar. Require KV Store server 7.0+, more than 50% free space on the data filesystem, healthy authenticated status, parallel backup and restore evidence, and a read-only maintenance window. ITSI 5.0.x and lower must postpone migration.
upgrade_notes_10_6.federated_search_remote_floor: All remote search heads and provider deployments must run Enterprise 10.4 or higher before upgrading the local deployment to 10.6.
upgrade_notes_10_6.cluster_ports: PostgreSQL network ports must be available between all cluster members for SPL2 availability.
upgrade_notes_10_6.encryption: Enterprise 10.6 supports the $8$ secret encryption format; legacy $7$ values remain readable. Re-encryption occurs only when an administrator invokes the migration CLI.
upgrade_notes_10_6.public_certificate_eku: Public TLS certificates used for inter-Splunk connections should no longer include Client Authentication EKU; obtain updated certificates before March 1, 2027.
